headline: RBL Bank Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - RBL Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of approval from the Reserve Bank of India for amalgamation of Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C. with RBL Bank Limited.
